command:
set +x
capstone_ids_before=$(docker compose ps -q backend frontend postgres | sort)
printf '%s\n' '$ docker compose up --build --no-recreate --no-deps -d --wait backend frontend postgres'
set +x
docker compose up --build --no-recreate --no-deps -d --wait backend frontend postgres > evidence/audit/compose-build-no-recreate.txt 2>&1
capstone_build_rc=$?
tail -n 16 evidence/audit/compose-build-no-recreate.txt
test "$capstone_build_rc" -eq 0
capstone_ids_after=$(docker compose ps -q backend frontend postgres | sort)
test "$capstone_ids_before" = "$capstone_ids_after"
printf 'PASS: original container IDs unchanged; no containers recreated.\n'
set -x
docker compose ps --format 'table {{.Service}}\t{{.Status}}\t{{.Ports}}'
docker image inspect relaydesk-backend:local relaydesk-frontend:local --format '{{.RepoTags}} user={{.Config.User}}'
